en-US: Export selected notes as a Markdown ZIP with attachments from the note list. Unsynced notes are skipped, and notes in trash cannot be exported.
Keep diagram auto-layout grouped, compact, and readable. Switching notes refits the canvas, and a newly inserted mind-map topic stays in view after Tab.
Fix dark-mode colors so they follow the theme instead of leftover utility remaps, while PDF paper stays white.
zh-CN: 笔记列表支持将选中笔记批量导出为带附件的 Markdown ZIP；未同步笔记会被跳过，回收站内笔记不可导出。
图表自动布局更紧凑、更易读；切换笔记后画布会重新适配，Tab 新建思维导图主题也会留在可视范围内。
修复深色模式下部分界面颜色与主题不一致的问题，PDF 预览仍保持白底。
